verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos.
verdicts.photo_observation: Page 11 (Cable Routing – rooftop): Red line (AC cable) shown running from the rooftop panel area toward the parapet. Page 12 (Cable Routing – upper): Red AC cable line continues down the exterior wall with a red trace; a second run also visible in the lower photo continuing down the wall exterior. Page 13 (interior equipment placement): ACDB–Inverter–DCDB grouping annotated with solar meter adjacent to the main meter panel. The routing shows rooftop → exterior wall run → ground floor equipment location → solar meter → main meter panel. However: (1) No photo explicitly shows conduit/trunking securing the cable on the exterior wall run; (2) The earth pit cable run (green/black lines on page 14) shows LA pit, DC Earth Pit, and AC Earth Pit annotated in the basement. The complete run from panels to DCDB on the rooftop is not shown (no rooftop DCDB visible in photos — only the cable leaving the roof edge).
verdicts.rationale: The cable routing is traced across multiple pages and appears logically consistent from rooftop to ground-floor equipment, but there are gaps: the rooftop DCDB is not visually shown (only overlaid in the 3D render), the exterior wall cable run lacks a photo confirming conduit/clipping method, and the connection between the rooftop DC cable exit and the ground-floor DCDB is implicit rather than photographically documented. Manual field verification of the full cable run continuity is recommended.
